reviews.comment: One of the hardest professors ever, lectures do not help at all. Be prepared to take detailed notes over every page of Griffiths. Exams are incredibly hard and homework do not help. The material is very enjoyable
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had him for PHYS 412, which wasn't an option to choose here, and he was great. Although I was more often than not distracted during the lecture, he published his notes on Canvas, and they were very helpful. He was very knowledgeable and nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Awful prof, while he is nice in person and often available during office hours, his lectures and hw and tests are not at all cohesive, and this course would have been much easier with any other prof in the dept.

Dr. Agnolet is a super good teacher, he grades not just by if your answers are correct, but if you used the right process. It's super important to be able to understand how the hw is done. Doing the hw in a group is advised and talk to him he's super nice and helpful when trying to learn a new topic.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things
